title: Client Feedback Evidence CLI
viewer: Hiring manager or general portfolio viewer
takeaway: This local workflow keeps the proof, source, and artifact together without exposing private feedback.

scenes.intent: Useful feedback was scattered. Chats, emails, voice notes, and files lived apart.
scenes.headline: Useful feedback was scattered.

scenes.intent: Copying evidence by hand broke the trail. Sources got lost.
scenes.headline: Manual copying broke the evidence trail.

scenes.intent: I built a local evidence folder. Private feedback stays on the machine.
scenes.headline: I built a local evidence folder.

scenes.intent: The tool gathers feedback from every source. Messages, files, audio, and transcripts stay together.
scenes.headline: Every source stays connected.
scenes.assetAlt: Evidence packet showing locally saved artifacts.

scenes.intent: The folder can be reused later. Claim, source, and evidence stay connected.
scenes.headline: The evidence can be reused later.
scenes.assetAlt: Reusable evidence packet with connected source artifacts.

scenes.intent: Scattered feedback becomes reusable evidence. The source stays attached.
scenes.headline: Scattered feedback becomes reusable evidence.

hide: private feedback text, contact information, emails, and profile photos
recordings, transcript text, raw evidence folders, and local paths
browser storage, OAuth state, cookies, and tokens
safe: public project name and source labels
synthetic redacted message cards and artifact labels
